--- select_left_lookup_join.sql
SELECT * FROM A LEFT OUTER LOOKUP JOIN B USING (id)

--- AST
&ast.QueryStatement{
  Query: &ast.Select{
    Results: []ast.SelectItem{
      &ast.Star{
        Star: 7,
      },
    },
    From: &ast.From{
      From:   9,
      Source: &ast.Join{
        Left: &ast.TableName{
          Table: &ast.Ident{
            NamePos: 14,
            NameEnd: 15,
            Name:    "A",
          },
        },
        Op:     "LEFT OUTER",
        Method: "LOOKUP",
        Right:  &ast.TableName{
          Table: &ast.Ident{
            NamePos: 39,
            NameEnd: 40,
            Name:    "B",
          },
        },
        Cond: &ast.Using{
          Using:  41,
          Rparen: 50,
          Idents: []*ast.Ident{
            &ast.Ident{
              NamePos: 48,
              NameEnd: 50,
              Name:    "id",
            },
          },
        },
      },
    },
  },
}

--- SQL
SELECT * FROM A LEFT OUTER LOOKUP JOIN B USING (id)
